comment: FM voice satellites SAT PASS can track. name = the satellite's name in CelesTrak's amateur-radio group (https://celestrak.org/NORAD/elements/gp.php?GROUP=amateur&FORMAT=tle); label = what the radio shows (7 characters at most); up / down in MHz as the satellite hears / sends; tone = the access CTCSS in Hz (0 = none). Frequencies from AMSAT's FM satellite listings (amsat.org/status, work-sat.com FM-VOICE-SATS-2026a, the REF QRG list of 2025-06-26): check amsat.org/status before going on air, several are intermittent or silent.

satellites.name: SAUDISAT 1C (SO-50)
satellites.label: SO-50
satellites.note: Arm its 10 minute timer first: a 2 second carrier with a 74.4 Hz tone, then 67.0 Hz.

satellites.name: ISS (ZARYA)
satellites.label: ISS
satellites.note: The ISS FM repeater is only on at times.

satellites.name: RADFXSAT (FOX-1B)
satellites.label: AO-91
satellites.note: AMSAT's April 2025 page says no tone is needed; other lists still show 67.0 Hz. Sunlit passes only.

satellites.name: DIWATA-2B
satellites.label: PO-101
satellites.note: Active only on a schedule; may be silent.

satellites.name: LILACSAT-2
satellites.label: LILAC2
satellites.note: Frequencies from memory, not in the AMSAT lists above.
